text:
Predicates:
Spicy(x) ::: x is spicy.
BakedSweet(x) ::: x is a baked sweet.
Cupcake(x) ::: x is a cupcake.
MalaHotpot(x) ::: x is a mala hotpot.
ProductOfMelissa(x) ::: x is a product from Baked by Melissa.
DriedThaiChili(x) ::: x is a dried Thai chili.
Premises:
∀x (BakedSweet(x) → ¬Spicy(x)) ::: No baked sweets are spicy.
∀x (Cupcake(x) → BakedSweet(x)) ::: All cupcakes are baked sweets.
∀x (MalaHotpot(x) → Spicy(x)) ::: All mala hotpots are spicy.
∀x (ProductOfMelissa(x) → Cupcake(x)) ::: All products from Baked by Melissa are cupcakes.
Spicy(driedThaiChili) ∨ MalaHotpot(driedThaiChili) ∨ ¬BakedSweet(driedThaiChili) ::: Dried Thai chilies are spicy or mala hotpots or not baked sweets.
Conclusion:
¬(ProductOfMelissa(driedThaiChili) ∨ BakedSweet(driedThaiChili)) ::: Dried Thai chilies are neither products of Baked by Melissa nor baked sweets.
